title: Wire Draw Dev Preview into Launch Config and Verify End to End
description: The `draw` technology (vector-graphics plugin app under draw/rs, draw/plugin/rs) has a working `bun run dev:draw` script and is registered in the generated framework-os playground catalog (framework/plugin/registry/generated/playgrounds.json, react port 6064, wgpu port 6164), but unlike every other playground app (puzzle2d, note, cad, etc.) it has NO entry in .claude/launch.json — devs can only launch it via CLI, which CLAUDE.md forbids ("All devs are using launch.json and never use the cli"). Register draw-react-dev and draw-wgpu-dev in .claude/launch.json following the existing note-react-dev/note-wgpu-dev pairing pattern (name, runtimeExecutable bun, runtimeArgs run dev:draw, env DRAW_PLAY_PORT + SEMIO_RENDERER, port). Then launch both via the preview tooling and verify draw actually works end to end in the browser: the Semio Emblem example loads, canvas renders paths/gradients, and at least one tool (marquee select or shape/pen draft) is interactive with no console errors. A prior ticket (26/07/10/DRAW-TECHNOLOGY-PREMIGRATION-PARITY-FOR-REACT-RENDERER, closed) restored the underlying react-renderer functionality and noted framework/renderer/wgpu was separately broken (pre-existing, unrelated UiNode::Image regression) — confirm whether that still blocks draw-wgpu-dev and note it in the ticket summary if so, without attempting to fix the wgpu renderer itself (out of scope).
summary:
Got the `draw` technology working end to end for the react renderer and registered its dev preview in launch.json (it previously had no entry at all, unlike every other playground app, despite `bun run dev:draw` and a catalog entry already existing).

Root cause found and fixed: draw/plugin/rs/lib.rs had 11 struct literals (UiTreeItemNode ×7, UiTreeSectionNode ×2, UiTreeNode ×2) missing the `loading: Option<bool>` field recently added to those shared framework/ui_wgpu types — this broke `cargo build -p draw-plugin`, so `bun run dev:draw` (react) failed outright with 11× E0063 errors before ever reaching the browser. Added `loading: None` to each literal, matching the existing pattern in framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's generate_mode tree builders. Verified with a standalone `cargo check -p draw-plugin` (clean).

.claude/launch.json: added draw-react-dev (port 6064) and draw-wgpu-dev (port 6164), following the note-react-dev/note-wgpu-dev pairing pattern (DRAW_PLAY_PORT + SEMIO_RENDERER env, bun run dev:draw).

Browser-verified draw-react-dev end to end at localhost:6064: app boots cleanly, loaded the "Semio" example (the emblem logo), canvas renders paths/gradients/colors correctly, marquee-drag and direct-click on canvas produced no console errors. Confirms the react-renderer parity work from ticket 26/07/10/DRAW-TECHNOLOGY-PREMIGRATION-PARITY-FOR-REACT-RENDERER is now actually reachable through a registered dev entry point.

draw-wgpu-dev does NOT work: `framework/renderer/wgpu` fails to compile with a different, framework-wide error — `cannot find function action_result_from_patch_ops in crate semio_framework_plugin` in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs. This blocks the wgpu renderer for every technology, not just draw, and is out of scope here; it's already tracked by the open ticket 26/07/11/WGPU-RENDERER-FULL-PARITY. The draw-wgpu-dev launch.json entry is registered and correctly wired (same pattern as other *-wgpu-dev entries) so it will work automatically once that ticket resolves the underlying framework/renderer/wgpu compile error.

Note: during verification I accidentally spawned several duplicate framework-os-dev:dev processes via repeated preview tool restarts, which caused resource contention and made the server appear to hang; cleaned those up before diagnosing the real compile error.
